Is India finally fixing its broken diet?
Despite being the world’s largest milk producer, 80% of Indians are protein deficient. But a ₹15,000 Crore "Protein Goldmine" is exploding, and startups are racing to disrupt India’s ₹4.5 Lakh Crore food industry.
From Amul’s massive pivot to Swiggy & Zomato’s secret AI health scores, the way we eat is being re-engineered behind the scenes. In this breakdown, we uncover the 3 waves of India’s food revolution and how new-age brands like The Whole Truth, SuperYou, and Lo! Foods are making "healthy" actually taste good.
